name: arc-gift
description: Send USDC like a gift on Arc: one link, fixed or random split, reclaim after expiry.

scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: cd contracts && forge fmt --check && forge lint && cd .. && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.build: cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && node scripts/sync-abi.mjs && npm --prefix web run build
